morphology.pattern_note: ter- 与 hina 直接结合，词首 h 保留。此处表示受到贬抑后的状态，不表示最高级，也不必然表示无意发生。

senses.zh_definition: 受到侮辱或被人轻视的；尊严受损而感到屈辱的。
senses.en_definition: Humiliated, demeaned, or treated as contemptible or inferior.
senses.ms_definition: Dipandang atau dianggap hina; telah dihinakan.
senses.nuances: 核心是尊严受到贬损，通常比普通的 malu（害羞、难为情）更强。berasa terhina 表示主观感受，不必然断定对方有意侮辱；terhina 本身也不等于“最卑贱”。[DBP：hina 及其派生词](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=hina)

dual_scenarios.context: 职场申诉 / 人事沟通
dual_scenarios.ms: Dalam aduannya, pekerja itu menyatakan bahawa beliau berasa terhina apabila diperlekehkan di hadapan rakan sekerja.
dual_scenarios.zh: 该员工在投诉中表示，自己在同事面前遭到贬低，因而感到受辱。
dual_scenarios.en: In the complaint, the employee stated that being belittled in front of colleagues had left them feeling humiliated.

dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Aku rasa terhina lah bila dia cakap macam tu depan semua orang.
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Saya berasa terhina apabila dia bercakap begitu di hadapan semua orang.
dual_scenarios.zh: 他当着大家的面那样说，我真的觉得很受辱。
dual_scenarios.en: I felt humiliated when he said that in front of everyone.

messages.speaker: Amir (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Aku rasa terhina lah bila dia cakap macam tu depan semua orang.
messages.ms_standard: Saya berasa terhina apabila dia bercakap begitu di hadapan semua orang.
messages.zh: 他当着大家的面那样说，我觉得很受辱。
messages.en: I felt humiliated when he said that in front of everyone.

messages.speaker: Farah (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Aku faham. Kalau kau nak, aku boleh teman kau jumpa dia nanti.
messages.ms_standard: Saya faham. Jika awak mahu, saya boleh menemani awak berjumpa dengannya nanti.
messages.zh: 我明白。你愿意的话，待会儿我可以陪你去找他谈。
messages.en: I understand. If you want, I can go with you to talk to him later.

etymology.historical_story: The root hina is traced to Sanskrit hīna, associated with being inferior, deficient, or lowly. Malay combines this borrowed root with its own prefix ter- to describe a state of humiliation. The resulting word directs attention to damaged dignity and the experience of being demeaned, rather than simply to shyness or embarrassment. [Historical lexical study](https://www.wisdomlib.org/history/book/sanskrit-words-in-southeast-asian-languages/ocr/1595120/529)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: hina 是“贬低、卑下”；terhina 把镜头转向承受者：被贬低了，心里感到屈辱。

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 表达强烈的尊严受损感。处理冲突时用 Saya berasa terhina apabila… 说明具体感受与触发行为，比直接指责对方更便于沟通。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 适用于描述羞辱、霸凌或轻蔑待遇。别人说自己 terhina 时，宜认真回应，不宜立即以 gurau sahaja（只是开玩笑）否定其感受。
